plan.notes: University of Northern Iowa 2025-26 Academic Catalog, Cybersecurity and System Administration B.S. official Plan of Study Grid. Catalog total: 120 hours; semester sums match exactly. Generic slots (UNIFI/General Education or University Electives, Area Elective, Computer Science Research) are recorded as choice placeholders using the official grid's slot labels. Area Elective slots follow the department's specialization-area requirements (Foundations / Data and Applications / Software Engineering). The plan notes students should meet with an academic advisor to include UNIFI/General Education and university elective hours.
